item.title: Xiase Siyecao
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Connection
  • 発売日: 2024-06-27
  • スコア: 7.83/10 (401 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏色四葉草
  • 英語名: Natsuiro Clover

别名

  • Natsuiro Clover

あらすじ

You are millions of dollars in debt and struggling to make ends meet as you toil away at your day job for a major conglomorate. Your life takes a frustrating turn for the worse when your colleagues repeatedly and falsely accuse you of sexual harassment.

In a twist of fate, your supervisor Shizuko proposed an unexpected job transfer—A position as housekeeper at your employers’ mansion! Along with a significant pay raise, you will also be given free room and board!

item.title: Xingfu de Errenfang
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Connection
  • 発売日: 2022-09-29
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (233 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 幸福的二人房
  • 英語名: Shiawase no Double Room

别名

  • 幸福的二人房

あらすじ

I’ve been kidnapped.

Kidnapped by a sister I have known for many years …

What is a right choice? No matter what you think and how you choose, you will eventually come to a desperate situation.But she told me —

It doesn’t matter if you choose a wrong path. Just do your best and it will turn out right.
